# Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia (ERIA)

> ERIA conducts economic research on industrial development, innovation, and SMEs across ASEAN and East Asia to support regional growth and integration.

ERIA is a leading think tank focused on understanding economic dynamics in Southeast Asia and East Asia. The institute produces research on manufacturing, technology adoption, and enterprise development that informs policy and business strategy across the region.

## Key Topics

- ASEAN
- East Asia
- Industry and Manufacturing
- Innovation and Technology
- SMEs
- Production Networks
- Supply Chain Logistics
- Technology Transfer
- Digital Transformation
- Industrial Development
- Multinational Corporations
- Public-Private Partnerships
- Cyber Security
- Renewable Energy
- Development Impact

## Core Research Areas

- [Industry and Manufacturing](https://www.eria.org/research/topic/industry-and-manufacturing): ERIA research on industry and manufacturing across ASEAN and East Asia
- [Innovation and Technology](https://www.eria.org/research/topic/innovation-and-technology): ERIA investigation of innovation and technology impact on development
- [SMEs](https://www.eria.org/research/topic/smes): ERIA research on small and medium-sized enterprises in Asian economies
